description: For a fixed arithmetic formula \(F\) and a tuple of numerical inputs \(\bar a\), the syntax code \(\ulcorner F(\overline{\bar a})\urcorner\) of its numeral instance is primitive recursive in \(\bar a\). More generally, substituting numeral values that depend primitive recursively on a parameter gives a primitive-recursive sentence code.
